title: Complete quadratic derivative bit
statement: For a positive integer $n$, let $x\colon\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb{F}_2$ and choose $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Define the complete quadratic derivative bit at $i$ to be the sum in $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the coordinates $x(j)$ over all $j\ne i$.
hypotheses_covered: A vector x with n coordinates in the field with two elements
An index i among the n coordinates
